en_title: Franchises Like Mass Effect Are a 'Prestige Project' for EA, and BioWare's Closure Was 'Entirely Predictable,' Analysts Say
subtitle: 声望项目也难逃裁撤
opus_summary: 分析师称，BioWare关闭早在EA被收购前就已显露征兆，《质量效应》等系列如今被视为声望项目。债务压力、成本控制以及《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》等作品表现不佳，让工作室的未来愈发黯淡。

paragraphs.en: Games industry analysts told IGN that BioWare was likely doomed well before EA’s $55 billion acquisition, explaining that games like Mass Effect are now considered “prestige projects” for the company, and it’s unlikely the sci-fi franchise, nor BioWare’s other IPs, are sold off.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏行业分析师告诉IGN，早在EA以550亿美元(约合人民币3674亿元)收购案之前，BioWare的命运或许就已注定。他们解释称，《质量效应》这类游戏如今被EA视为「声望项目」，而这款科幻系列及BioWare旗下其他IP恐怕都不太可能被出售。

paragraphs.en: On October 21, EA announced a major shift in strategy and a significant internal restructuring that involves the cancelation of a number of projects, the closure of BioWare , and a reported 400 people losing their jobs. The Canadian studio, known for franchises like Mass Effect and Dragon Age, was shut down after more than 30 years of creating beloved role-playing games. Mass Effect fans must now consider that the franchise is dead — something the leaked internal trailer for Mass Effect Universe made all the more difficult to accept.
paragraphs.cn: 10月21日，EA宣布大幅调整战略并进行重大内部重组，其中包括取消多个项目、关闭BioWare，以及据报道裁员约400人。这家加拿大工作室凭借《质量效应》和《龙腾世纪》等系列闻名，在制作备受喜爱的角色扮演游戏逾30年后关门。如今，《质量效应》的粉丝不得不面对系列可能就此终结的现实；此前泄露的内部预告片《Mass Effect Universe》更让人难以接受这一点。

paragraphs.en: Needless to say, Mass Effect fans were gutted by the news, hoping against hope that EA might sell off BioWare’s IP rather than letting them languish in obscurity. But analysts have expressed doubt that outside companies will take on BioWare's franchises, even as EA faces down a massive debt incurred by its acquisition.
paragraphs.cn: 消息显然让《质量效应》粉丝心碎不已，他们仍抱着一线希望，盼望EA出售BioWare的IP，而不是任由这些作品逐渐被遗忘。但分析师怀疑，其他公司是否愿意接手BioWare的系列作品；与此同时，EA还要应对收购带来的巨额债务。

paragraphs.en: When asked about this possibility, industry analyst Joost van Dreunen said, “maybe,” but explained that these IPs are likely far too costly — and far too time-consuming — for other developers to tackle.
paragraphs.cn: 被问及这种可能性时，行业分析师Joost van Dreunen回答「也许」，但他解释说，这些IP的开发成本和所需时间恐怕都高得惊人，其他开发商很难接手。

paragraphs.en: “In many ways, BioWare's IP is in the same boat as some of the other studios we recently saw being divested. They are all well-known and too expensive for most buyers. Capable publishers like CD Projekt Red already have their hands full with their own projects,” he said. (He’s not wrong; CDPR certainly has a lot on its plate right now, what with The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2 being in active development.)
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「在很多方面，BioWare的IP与我们最近看到被剥离的其他一些工作室处境相同。它们都很有名，但对大多数买家来说价格过高。像CDPR这样有实力的发行商，光是自己的项目就已经忙不过来了。」他说得没错，CDPR目前正积极开发《巫师4》和《赛博朋克2》，手头的工作确实不少。

paragraphs.en: The next Mass Effect was announced six years ago, at The Game Awards 2020, and this time last year Mike Gamble, now former executive producer of Mass Effect at BioWare, celebrated N7 Day to say the game was still in development. He even expressed excitement about the Amazon TV series ( which IGN understands is currently still in the works ), and insisted EA and BioWare "remain committed to telling more stories in this universe."
paragraphs.cn: 下一部《质量效应》早在六年前的2020年游戏大奖上就已公布。就在去年此时，时任BioWare《质量效应》执行制作人的Mike Gamble还在N7日表示，游戏仍在开发中。他当时甚至表达了对亚马逊电视剧的期待——据IGN了解，该剧目前仍在制作中——并坚称EA和BioWare「仍致力于讲述这个宇宙中的更多故事」。

paragraphs.en: So what changed? Why cancel Mass Effect 5 now? Van Dreunen told us that, in EA’s eyes, legacy IPs like Mass Effect are likely being viewed as “prestige projects,” and the future looks grim for other development teams still underneath EA’s umbrella.
paragraphs.cn: 那么，究竟发生了什么变化？EA为何此时取消《质量效应5》？Van Dreunen告诉我们，在EA看来，《质量效应》这类老牌IP或许已成了「声望项目」，而仍在EA旗下的其他开发团队前景也不容乐观。

paragraphs.en: "Before its buyout, EA had been focusing on building recurring revenue streams, and the focus of its new owners is sports, live service, and new markets like Asia. Even if Mass Effect and Dragon Age were fantastically successful, corporate will insist on predictable cash flow. It makes franchises like Mass Effect a prestige project,” he continued.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「在被收购前，EA一直专注于建立持续收入来源；新东家的重点则是体育游戏、服务型游戏，以及亚洲等新市场。即便《质量效应》和《龙腾世纪》成绩非常出色，公司层面仍会坚持追求可预测的现金流。这让《质量效应》这样的系列成了声望项目。」

paragraphs.en: “Considering the debt load, I'd expect to hear about more layoffs in the months to come. The memo already shrinks the skate. team and pauses a project for The Sims. I expect EA's town hall in November to bring more bad news."
paragraphs.cn: 「考虑到债务负担，我预计未来几个月还会听到更多裁员消息。内部备忘录已经宣布缩减《skate.》团队，并暂停一个《模拟人生》项目。我预计EA在11月召开的全员大会还会带来更多坏消息。」

paragraphs.en: Van Dreunen, along with fellow analyst Piers Harding-Rolls of Ampere, considers BioWare’s closure an inevitable consequence of EA’s current business structure, calling it “entirely predictable and precisely what a leveraged buyout looks like once the deal closes.
paragraphs.cn: Van Dreunen和Ampere的另一位分析师Piers Harding-Rolls都认为，BioWare关闭是EA当前商业架构下不可避免的结果；Van Dreunen称，这「完全可以预见，正是杠杆收购完成后会出现的局面」。

paragraphs.en: “In this case, EA now carries roughly $18 billion in debt, which costs it about $1.8 billion a year in interest. That is more than its annual EBITDA of around $1.5 billion. EA has told its lenders it will cut $700 million in annual costs to service the debt. In that context, a 50-person team working on a game that is years from launch is the easiest line to cut, regardless of its legacy,” van Dreunen said.
paragraphs.cn: Van Dreunen说：「在这笔交易中，EA如今背负约180亿美元(约合人民币1202亿元)债务，每年利息约18亿美元(约合人民币120亿元)，高于其约15亿美元(约合人民币100亿元)的年度EBITDA。EA已告知贷款方，将每年削减7亿美元(约合人民币47亿元)成本以偿还债务。在这种情况下，一个由50人组成、负责开发一款还要数年才会推出的游戏的团队，最容易成为削减对象，无论它过去有何成就。」

paragraphs.en: “This news is emotive for many adult gamers because of Bioware’s long history of delivering games with deep narratives that connect with audiences, meaning it has a large cultural footprint. It’s a name that has been around for 30 years, so seeing it close is a significant moment for the industry. In particular, the original Baldur’s Gate games, Neverwinter Nights, and KOTOR were genre defining, and the later Mass Effect titles also strongly resonated with audiences,” Harding-Rolls told us.
paragraphs.cn: Harding-Rolls告诉我们：「对于许多成年玩家来说，这则消息触动很深，因为BioWare长期以来都在制作叙事深刻、能与玩家产生共鸣的游戏，因此留下了深远的文化影响。这个名字已经存在了30年，如今看到工作室关闭，对整个行业而言都是重要时刻。尤其是早期的《博德之门》系列、《无冬之夜》和《星球大战：旧共和国武士》定义了各自的类型，后来的《质量效应》作品也同样深受玩家共鸣。」

paragraphs.en: Harding-Rolls added that the commercial failure of BioWare's last game, Dragon Age: The Veilguard, played a part in BioWare's demise. And let's remember that 2017's Mass Effect: Andromeda and 2019's Anthem also failed to meet EA's expectations.
paragraphs.cn: Harding-Rolls还指出，BioWare上一款游戏《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》商业表现不佳，也是工作室走向衰亡的原因之一。别忘了，2017年的《质量效应：仙女座》和2019年的《圣歌》也未达到EA的预期。

paragraphs.en: “Unfortunately, the studio’s recent big-budget releases have not performed well enough commercially," he said. "Ampere data shows that Bioware’s latest release at the end of 2024 — Dragon Age: The Veilguard — has sold an estimated 1.9 million units globally across PlayStation, Xbox, and Steam up to the end of September, way below internal targets. The changing nature of high-end gaming and the need to cut costs means that it is likely that Bioware’s future was under discussion before EA was acquired by the PIF and its partners.”
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「遗憾的是，工作室近期推出的高预算游戏在商业表现上都不够理想。Ampere数据显示，截至9月底，BioWare于2024年底推出的最新作品《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》在PlayStation、XBOX和Steam平台全球销量估计为190万份，远低于内部目标。高端游戏市场正在变化，加上削减成本的需求，BioWare的未来很可能在EA被PIF及其合作伙伴收购之前就已成为讨论议题。」

paragraphs.en: It's a point backed up by MST Financial analyst David Gibson. “I think the closing is a combination of factors: EA going private and needing to improve returns and margins to fund large debt, high relative costs in the West (versus Asia, etc.) to develop AAA games, and role playing games like Mass Effect not doing enough sales to be profitable enough,” he explained.
paragraphs.cn: MST Financial分析师David Gibson也支持这一观点。他解释说：「我认为工作室关闭是多种因素共同作用的结果：EA转为非上市公司后，需要提高回报和利润率以支撑巨额债务；与亚洲等地区相比，西方开发AAA游戏的相对成本较高；此外，《质量效应》这类角色扮演游戏的销量不足以带来足够利润。」

paragraphs.en: “It appears there were many other games in development using IP which were also scrapped. I would hope a small and nimble studio would acquire some of the IP and make great games that users love and that contain innovation, rather than repeat the same stuff. EA has a history of making a series of games that are just not fun to play or contain innovation.”
paragraphs.cn: 「看起来，还有许多使用这些IP开发的游戏也被取消了。我希望有规模小、行动灵活的工作室能收购部分IP，制作玩家喜爱且富有创新的优秀游戏，而不是重复老一套。EA过去推出过一些系列作品，玩起来并不有趣，也缺乏创新。」

paragraphs.en: Whether or not EA ends up selling off BioWare’s IP remains to be seen. Former BioWare executive producer Mark Darrah is more optimistic about this possibility than he was previously, but remains skeptical, saying EA could be just as likely to “forget they ever existed and bury them in the vault.”
paragraphs.cn: EA最终是否会出售BioWare的IP，仍有待观察。BioWare前执行制作人Mark Darrah如今对此比过去乐观一些，但依然持怀疑态度。他表示，EA也完全可能「假装它们从未存在过，然后把它们封存在资料库里」。

paragraphs.en: We have much more on the dramatic news of BioWare's closure, including reaction from fans and the video game industry , and IGN's Ryan McCaffrey on why BioWare was the greatest RPG developer ever .
paragraphs.cn: 关于BioWare关闭这一重大消息，我们还报道了粉丝和游戏行业的反应；IGN的Ryan McCaffrey也谈到了为何BioWare曾是史上最出色的角色扮演游戏开发商。
